newsitem.title: USA: Oilex acquires 60 more Xeric wells.
newsitem.headline: Oilex acquires 60 more Xeric wells.

text.p: Oilex Inc said it has acquired 60 wells in the Permian Basin in Scurry and Mitchell counties, Texas, from privately owned Xeric Oil & Gas Corp of Midland.
An Oilex spokesman said Xeric retained a 25 percent working interest in the wells, which have an estimated 1.5 million barrels of oil remaining in place.
He also said Xeric retained a 12.5 percent interest in the 28 Scurry County wells Oilex acquired last month for a payment of $30,000.

Oilex said it is conducting salvage operations on the 60 additional wells to remove all downhole tubing, rods, pumps, and surface jacks and will employ its portable swabbing unit to enhance the production from these oil and natural gas wells.
Oilex also said Xeric chief executive Randall L. Capps has joined the company's board.
The spokesman said he holds one million Oilex shares.
